title: 第17章 好巧啊第18章 迷路了
slug: 为了长生不死我带着全宗修仙
content_zh:
;;
寂月调动全身的灵力凝聚在剑身，一边运转着功法，让周围的灵气源源不断地进入体内。
这是种非常危险的方式，一边进气一边出气，稍有不慎，体内灵气乱窜下来的话，轻则经脉尽碎，重则爆体而亡。
如果不是之前修炼的《金钟护体神功》强化了她的体能，只怕是更危险。
一般的炼气期修士是没有这么庞大的灵力储存量，但寂月就不是这个一般人。
无论是修炼的功法还是自身的灵根资质，都给了她得天独厚的待遇。
即便等级上比不过那妖兽，但是拼灵力的话，她未必会输。
花玲珑以及周围的几个随从就这么惊愕地看着她表演，僵持数招下来，并不落于下风，反而把那妖兽的灵力消耗得不剩多少。
但是越阶斩杀筑基期妖兽也不是一件容易的事情。
为了避免日后被这妖兽记仇，寂月必定不能心软，要在自己有这个实力的时候就将其解决。
万一对方回去后得了什么机缘回来咋办。
看出那妖兽欲逃，寂月一个闪身过去拦住。
右手执剑指向天空，周围狂风大振，吹动着她的衣袍和发丝，她的面色却是一点不变。
云层之上，紫色的雷电闪现，连带着附近的云层都暗了下来，一时间，周围的地界都灰暗了不少。
城中不少人还以为要下雨，想着赶紧回家收衣服。
只有寂月自己知道自己是扛着多大的压力，无数的灵气冲进她的体内，浑身上下都疼，痛到一定境界了之后，就变得麻木，几乎都快感受不到这疼痛。
妖兽嘶吼一声过后，一道甩尾过来，企图打算施法。
但它的速度比不上落雷的速度。
一道粗壮的紫色雷电从天而降，稳稳当当地劈在妖兽的身上。
噼里啪啦的，先是一股肉香传了出来，过了一会儿，传来了一股焦香，再之后，雷电散去，原地只剩一团灰。

这是妖丹都给劈没了啊？
花玲珑看向前方，浮在半空中的女人，面色冷然，白色的衣袍鼓荡，长发仅由一根木簪挽起，几缕青丝飞扬在脸颊，明明一切都看起来普普通通，但刚刚发生的一切都表示着不普通。
对方转头，轻飘飘看过来的一眼，不带任何情绪，却瞬间让她的血液沸腾起来。
区区筑基？
方才以为这位道友是在说大话，现在看来，只怕不是这么一回事。
所以她决定了！
“师父！我是你失散多年的徒儿啊～”
寂月好悬没从空中摔下去，这是她好不容易保持的逼格，只要不是飞，还是能利用灵力让自己悬空的。
就是她现在身体都僵了下来，刚刚被庞大的灵气冲刷了经脉，引雷的时候又被雷电舔舐了一遍全身，她现在哪里都是麻的。
功法是个好功法，但是她真的，不想再经历一遍了。
随从一号看着那地上的焦黑，喃喃：“这到底是何方神圣，居然轻轻松松就引来了天雷！”
那可是紫色的雷电，不是普通的雷电。
修士渡劫也是划分等级的，蓝色是最普通的，一般面向那些资质不怎么好的，但也注定了以后的修为不高。

Jiyue mobilized all her spiritual power to concentrate on the sword body, while running her skills, allowing the surrounding spiritual energy to continuously enter her body.
This is a very dangerous method. You are breathing in and out at the same time. If you are not careful, if the spiritual energy in the body rushes out randomly, the meridians will be completely shattered, and the body will explode and die.
If it weren't for the "Golden Bell Body Protection Magic" she had practiced before that strengthened her physical ability, she would have been even more dangerous.
Ordinary monks in the Qi refining stage do not have such a huge amount of spiritual power storage, but Jiyue is not such an ordinary person.
Whether it was the skills she practiced or her own spiritual root qualifications, she was given a unique treatment.
Even if she can't compare to the monster in terms of level, she may not lose if she fights for spiritual power.
Hua Linglong and several followers around her watched her performance in astonishment. After a few moves, they were not at a disadvantage. On the contrary, they depleted the monster's spiritual power.
But it is not an easy task to kill the foundation-building monsters beyond the level.
In order to avoid being resented by this monster in the future, Jiyue must not be soft-hearted and must deal with it when she has the strength.
What if the other party has an opportunity to come back after returning?
Seeing that the monster was trying to escape, Jiyue ducked over to stop it.
She held the sword in her right hand and pointed it at the sky. The strong wind was blowing around her, blowing her clothes and hair, but her expression did not change at all.
Above the clouds, purple thunder and lightning flashed, and the nearby clouds darkened. For a moment, the surrounding land became much darker.
Many people in the city thought it was going to rain and wanted to go home and collect their clothes.
Only Jiyue herself knew how much pressure she was carrying. Countless spiritual energy rushed into her body, causing pain all over her body. After the pain reached a certain level, she became numb and could hardly feel the pain.
After the monster roared, it swung its tail and tried to cast a spell.
But its speed cannot match the speed of thunder.
A thick purple thunderbolt fell from the sky and struck the monster firmly.
There was a crackle, first the smell of meat came out, and after a while, there was the smell of burning. Then, the thunder and lightning dispersed, leaving only a cloud of ashes.
Has the demon elixir been destroyed?
Hua Linglong looked forward, and saw the woman floating in mid-air with a cold expression, her white robe billowing, her long hair held up only by a wooden hairpin, and a few strands of black hair flying on her cheeks. Obviously everything looked ordinary, but everything that had just happened meant that it was extraordinary.
The other party turned her head and glanced over lightly, without any emotion, but it instantly made her blood boil.
Just building a foundation?
Just now I thought that this fellow Taoist was talking big words, but now it seems that this is not the case.
So she decided!
"Master! I am your long-lost disciple~"
Jiyue managed to avoid falling from the air. This was a feat she had managed to maintain. As long as she was not flying, she could still use her spiritual power to keep herself suspended.
Even her body was stiff now. Her meridians had just been flushed by the huge spiritual energy, and her whole body was licked by lightning when the thunder was triggered. She was numb everywhere now.
The technique was a good one, but she really didn't want to go through it again.
Follower No. 1 looked at the charred blackness on the ground and murmured: "Who the hell is this? It actually attracted thunder from the sky so easily!"
That was purple thunder and lightning, not ordinary thunder and lightning.
There are also levels for monks to overcome tribulations. Blue is the most common and is generally for those who are not very qualified, but are destined to have low cultivation levels in the future.
